author: Antonialock
body:
This inference is made from SGD annotations to this paper: 23899355

I think the term should be negative regulation of GCN2-mediated signaling, which doesn't exist 

In my understanding:
General amino acid control / amino acid response is triggered by uncharged tRNAs. GCN1/GCN20 help deliver uncharged tRNAs to GCN2. Activated GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2alpha, -> upregulation of GCN4/ATF4 and downregulation of global protein synthesis

GIR2+RBG1 form a complex that binds GCN1, so it competes with GCN2 for GCN1 binding. The authors of 23899355 suggest it helps finetune the response to amino acid starvation.

SGD is the only group that has annotated to GO:1903833 

I will request the neg reg term, I think yih1 should also be annotated to this term (it also binds GCN1)
